args.body:
- Apparel return rates reached 24% in 2026, making returns a major cost driver for retailers.
- Consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by roughly a fifth (20%).
- Reselling returned items within 10 days preserved most of the original margin.

Sources: https://blog.brightline.example/2026/returns and https://insights.brightline.example/returns/companion
